test_title: RRB ALP CBT-II (Armature and Coil Winder) Official Paper (Held On: 06 May, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Two trains of lengths 155 m and 160 m are running at speeds of 74 km/hr and 52 km/hr, respectively, on parallel tracks in opposite directions. In how many seconds will they pass each other?
solution:
**Given:**

Length of Train 1 (L₁) = 155 m

Length of Train 2 (L₂) = 160 m

Speed of Train 1 (S₁) = 74 km/hr

Speed of Train 2 (S₂) = 52 km/hr

**Formula used:**

Time = Total Distance / Relative Speed

Relative Speed (in m/s) = (S₁ + S₂) × (1000/3600)

**Calculation:**

Relative Speed = (74 + 52) × (1000/3600)

⇒ Relative Speed = 126 × (5/18)

⇒ Relative Speed = 35 m/s

Total Distance = L₁ + L₂

⇒ Total Distance = 155 + 160

⇒ Total Distance = 315 m

Time = 315 / 35

⇒ Time = 9 seconds

**∴ The correct answer is option (1).**
